meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: Claude 会按固定流程为 HyperFrames 合成编写关键帧动画:先明确动画主体、可见状态与时长,再选最小实现机制(GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等),并用 hyperframes 命令行验证,失败就修正关键帧。
howto.when: 当你想为 HyperFrames 合成添加可安全跳转的 2D/3D 关键帧、GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧等,或运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断时触发。不用于场景整体策略、品牌设计或媒体素材。

say.text: 给这个合成里的主体加一组 GSAP 关键帧,从起点移到终点并保持最终状态。
say.note: 会按 seek-safe 规则创建时间线并注册。

say.text: 用 CSS 关键帧让标题淡入,动画结束停在最终帧。
say.note: 会设置有限时长和 fill-mode both。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断,列出不达标的帧。
say.note: 会输出诊断结果并指出问题。

howto.what_en: Claude will author keyframe animations for HyperFrames compositions: identify the animated subject, visible states and duration, choose the smallest mechanism (GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, etc.), then verify via the hyperframes CLI and fix failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, etc., or when running hyperframes keyframes diagnostics. Not for scene strategy, brand design, or media sourcing.

say_en.text: Animate the title with CSS keyframes and keep the final frame after it ends.
say_en.note: Sets finite duration and fill-mode both.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes diagnostics and list frames that don't pass.
